title: Welcome
slide_intent: Establish who the rules serve and who approves their use so partners know how to produce accountable communications.
strategic_value: The partner and sponsor framing can protect Uber’s identity when another organization leads the creative work.
demonstration: An introduction and approval requirement sit beside a four-section contents list covering logo, color, typography and assets.
practical_value: Determine whether a project falls within this partner guide and route partner-led creative for the stated approval.

content_islands.name: Welcome heading
content_islands.spec: Place the section heading at the upper left.

content_islands.name: Audience and approval
content_islands.spec: Group the partner/sponsor audience, two assistance goals and pre-approval statement in the left column.

content_islands.name: Contents
content_islands.spec: Align the numbered four-section outline in the right column; keep subtopics beneath their parent sections.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction says the guide safeguards the brand and helps partners reference it correctly and access correct assets.
reference_purposes.Application: The page identifies partner and sponsor communications as its working context.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page requires all partner-led creatives to be pre-approved by the Uber brand team.
